response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with current staff-level experience and recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic-workflow tooling at re:cinq. However, the role explicitly requires 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions, and the resume shows only about one year of GenAI-adjacent work with no demonstrated RAG, vector database, evaluation-pipeline, or multi-agent framework experience, and Python is notably absent from the skills list. The breadth, teaching/workshop background, and cloud/TypeScript depth make an interview defensible, but the core AI experience gap is substantial for a Staff GenAI FDE role.
strengths: 15+ years of production software engineering across web, backend, embedded, and high-throughput distributed systems
Current hands-on work on MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure at a staff level
Strong customer/community-facing skills evidenced by workshops, conference talks, and courses — relevant to forward-deployed work
concerns: Falls far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1 year of GenAI exposure)
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI
Python — a key required technology — is not listed among skills or used in any described role

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG/vector DB/eval and Python evidence
